description: Gates 1 and 2 open and all 200 base slimes woken as size-1 train slimes, each its sleeper's species, not at bedtime (no session); switch 3 and basket 3 untouched. Along the loop line, not stacked, in 300 px stretches of loop (a slime's stretch: its loop distance / 300, rounded down): 3 per 100 px (9 a stretch), the bowl's bottom two stretches at 4 per 100 px (12 each), each slime on the loop, evenly spaced in its stretch. The bowl's bottom two stretches first, then the stretches behind and ahead alternately, behind first, none past switch 3 (the stretch it cuts takes 9 in proportion). As saved, stretches 55 and 56 have 12, 40 to 54 and 57 to 59 have 9, stretch 60 has 6 and stretch 39 the last 8 (loop distances 11,719 to 18,197, x 10.08 to 15.62 screens: back through gate 2, over basket 2 and past switch 2); 70 are in the bowl (x 13.5 to 15.33 screens). The camera on the bowl. The dense moving case, target at least 30 fps (chunk 22m; D153 as amended by D154).
